title: fix(test-infra): 13 package tests root their repo reads at the test file, not at the cwd
body:
Fixes #7799

`--root` moves **vitest's** root and leaves `process.cwd()` in the package directory, so a
test that builds a repo path out of the cwd reaches a different verdict under
`pnpm --filter PKG test` / `turbo run test` than under the repo-root form CI runs.

Every reading below is from one tree with **cwd as the only variable**:

- repo-root form: `pnpm exec vitest run PATH`
- package-dir form: `cd packages/PKG && pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. PATH` — the package
  `test` script's own spelling, and this card's acceptance reading

## The 16-row triage — measured, not read off the code

Every file is 1 test file in every run, so only test counts vary. `p` = passed, `f` = failed.

| # | file | project | repo root before → after | package dir before → after | classification |
|---:|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts` | unit | 41p → 41p | 41p → 41p | **already-immune** (counter-probed) |
| 2 | `packages/components/src/__tests__/browser-process-shim-scope.test.ts` | unit | 5p → 5p | 1p/**4f** → 5p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 3 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/auth-namespace-3546.test.tsx` | dom | 35p → 35p | 33p/**2f** → 35p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 4 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/common-search-retired-4392.test.ts` | unit | 5p → 5p | 3p/**2f** → 5p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 5 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/console-namespace-3546.test.tsx` | dom | 34p → 34p | 30p/**4f** → 34p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 6 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-preview-namespace-3546.test.tsx` | dom | 46p → 46p | 40p/**6f** → 46p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 7 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts` | unit | 5p → 5p | 4p/**1f** → 5p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 8 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/organization-namespace-3546.test.tsx` | dom | 20p → 20p | 19p/**1f** → 20p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 9 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx` | dom | 49p → 49p | 44p/**5f** → 49p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 10 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/report-editor-retired-4145.test.ts` | unit | 6p → 6p | 4p/**2f** → 6p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 11 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` | dom | 43p → 43p | 32p/**11f** → 43p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 12 | `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/showEmptyRelated-plural-base-3863.test.tsx` | dom | 31p → 31p | 28p/**3f** → 31p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 13 | `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupedPartialDisclosure-7189.test.tsx` | dom | 13p → 13p | 12p/**1f** → 13p | **loud-red** → repaired |
| 14 | `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.hostOnlyViewTypes.test.tsx` | dom | 7p → 7p | 7p → 7p | **already-immune** (counter-probed) |
| 15 | `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ViewSwitcher.test.tsx` | dom | 6p → 6p | 6p → 6p | **already-immune** (counter-probed) |
| 16 | `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx` | dom | 14p → 14p | 14p → 14p | **already-immune** (counter-probed) |

**Totals for the 16: 360 tests. Repo root 360p/0f before and after. Package dir 318p/42f before,
360p/0f after.**

### The vacuous-green count is ZERO — and that is a measurement, not a reading

The card named this the half that mattered and did not census it. Four files were green under
both cwds. A vacuous pass is the kind you cannot see by reading, so each was **counter-probed**:
a temporary assertion that the scan really scanned what it claims to scan, run under both cwds,
then reverted (blob-hash equality plus an empty `git diff HEAD` on all four).

- **Rows 14-16, plugin-view** — probes asserted the resolved source is non-empty and carries its
  expected anchor (the `#region` marker; a non-empty read feeding `parseMapEntries`). **Green under
  both cwds, 27p/27p.** Their two-candidate `existsSync` probe genuinely covers both cwds; the same
  bytes are read either way. Not vacuous.
- **Row 1, cli** — the probe **fired**, which is what proves probes of this shape have teeth:
  `expect(contextOfCurrentProcess().isMonorepo).toBe(true)` is green at the repo root and red from
  the package directory (`AssertionError: PROBE7799 ambient isMonorepo: expected false to be true`).
  So the ambient branch *does* differ by cwd — but the file is still **not defective**, because
  `contextOfCurrentProcess()` feeds **both sides** of the comparison, and the real `createTempApp`
  under test derives its own context from the same ambient cwd. Both sides move together, the
  compared map is non-empty either way, and its `REPO_ROOT` is already file-derived
  (`resolve(__dirname, '../../../..')`). Rewriting it would **desync** the mirror and turn a
  passing test red. Left alone deliberately, and reported rather than guessed at — see Open
  question below.

## The repair

The 13 defective files derive the root from their own `import.meta.url`, copying the landed
precedent of #7791 (**PR #7796**) rather than inventing a second spelling:

```ts
const SELF_DEPTH_BELOW_REPO_ROOT = 5; // packages / PKG / src / __tests__ / this file
const REPO_ROOT = decodeURIComponent(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname)
  .split('/')
  .slice(0, -SELF_DEPTH_BELOW_REPO_ROOT)
  .join('/');
```

Both shorter spellings the precedent measured and rejected were re-checked against **these**
packages rather than assumed:

- `dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` — the precedent hit `TS2591` because
  `packages/fields`' `tsconfig.test.json` deliberately names no `types`. **That constraint does not
  bind here**: `components`, `i18n` and `plugin-grid` all name `types: ['node', ...]`, so this form
  would compile. The precedent's spelling is used anyway — one spelling across `unit` and `dom`,
  and the landed one.
- `new URL(rel, import.meta.url)` — the two-argument form Vite rewrites. Not used; only bare
  `import.meta.url` is read and taken apart by hand.

**A premise seven of these files stated in prose is falsified here.** They said "`import.meta.url`
is not a file: URL in the dom project". Measured on this card, injected temporarily into a `dom`
`.test.tsx`, a `unit` `.test.ts` and a `plugin-grid` `.test.tsx`, under **both** cwds, all six
readings were identical:

```
URLPROBE7799 packages/i18n/src/__tests__/showEmptyRelated-plural-base-3863.test.tsx
  => file:///home/user/objectui-issue-7799/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/showEmptyRelated-plural-base-3863.test.tsx
```

It is a real `file://` URL in both projects. What Vite rewrites is the two-argument form.

## The corrected prose (row 2, and two more carrying the same false premise)

`browser-process-shim-scope.test.ts:69-72` taught the premise #7791 falsified — "Root-form Vitest
only (`scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` rejects a package-cwd run), so `process.cwd()` is the
repo root". The guard rejects a run whose **vitest** root is not the repo root; the package script
sets that root correctly and leaves cwd in the package. The guard passes and the cwd is the
package. That block is rewritten to say so, with this card's measurement (5 passed from the repo
root, 4 failed / 1 passed from the package directory).

Two other files carried the same false premise and are corrected the same way:
`objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts` and — see below —
`container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx`.

**No assertion is loosened and none becomes a conditional skip.** Row 2 is the delicate one,
because its assertion's *subject* is `process.cwd()`: the file exists to pin that
`process.cwd()` **compiles** in this package. That call stays, and its runtime check stays. What
changed is that its old runtime line asserted something else entirely — that cwd **is the repo
root** (`existsSync(join(cwd, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))`), true only under one invocation. That claim
is kept, rooted at the file instead of the cwd, and the cwd binding is still checked for being real:

```ts
const cwd: string = process.cwd();
expect(typeof cwd).toBe('string');
expect(isAbsolute(cwd)).toBe(true);
expect(existsSync(cwd)).toBe(true);
expect(existsSync(join(REPO_ROOT, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))).toBe(true);
```

## A 17th file, found by running the acceptance invocation itself

`packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx` — **13p from
the repo root, 7p/6f from the package directory.** The card's census regex could not see it: it
spells the read as `(globalThis as unknown as { process: { cwd(): string } }).process.cwd()`, an
indirection around this package's browser `process` shim that
`(join|resolve)\(\s*process\.cwd\(\)` cannot match.

It is **byte-identical to `origin/main`** on this branch's base
(`462f98468dbfaa5a30623865c5f0b6e83c5a1332` at both `HEAD` and `origin/main`), so its red is
pre-existing, not a regression here. It is repaired in this PR because leaving it would have left
**`pnpm --filter @object-ui/components test` — this card's own acceptance reading — red**, which is
the deliverable itself. Same defect class, same mechanical repair, same gate family, no new
verification surface, and no other claim holds that file. Its prose carried **both** false premises
(the guard one, and "`import.meta.url` is an `http://` module URL under vite"); both are corrected.
Deriving from `import.meta.url` reads no `process` at all, so the `globalThis` dance is simply gone
— the shim's own compile pin is untouched and still lives in row 2's file.

A wider census over every test file under `packages/*/src` mentioning `cwd()` returns **19**. The
remaining two beyond this PR's 17 are `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts` and
`packages/cli/src/__tests__/validate-widget-namespace.test.ts` — **measured green under both cwds,
44p/44p**, so nothing is owed there.

## The lit control

Target: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/common-search-retired-4392.test.ts` (the card's own measured
file). Its file-derived root was put back to `const REPO_ROOT = process.cwd();` under
`trap ... EXIT INT TERM`, restored with `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`.

Mutation confirmed **on disk before the run** — injected form present 1, file-derived form 0, blob
moved `b15b16de` → `9d16b0a1` (an empty hash would have read as failure and stopped the run):

```
package dir  Tests  2 failed | 3 passed (5)
  AssertionError: scan root missing:
    /home/user/objectui-issue-7799/packages/i18n/packages: expected false to be true
  at packages/i18n/src/__tests__/common-search-retired-4392.test.ts:211
repo root    Tests  5 passed (5)
```

It goes red **and names itself** under the package-dir form while staying green at the repo root —
so the control is cwd-specific, not a broken file. Restoration proved by **state, not by whether
the trap fired**: HEAD blob `b15b16de308d87d5d0a29628ff7d1c9426524676` equals the disk blob,
`git diff HEAD --name-only` is empty, and the mutated spelling is absent from disk. `RESTORE_PROOF=CLEAN`.

## Verification

All runs at the final commit `87fef80ab`, through the container's shared verify lock. Exit codes
were captured by redirecting first and reading the status before any pipe.

| command | result |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components test` (acceptance form) | **233 files / 2166 tests passed**, exit 0 — was **1 file / 6 tests red** |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test` | **62 files / 1031 tests passed**, exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid test` | **112 files / 1015 tests passed**, exit 0 |
| `turbo run type-check` (i18n, components, plugin-grid) | 16/16 tasks successful, exit 0 |
| `turbo run lint` (i18n, components, plugin-grid) | 4/4 tasks successful, **0 errors** (925 pre-existing warnings, all `react-refresh` in `components/src/ui/**`) |
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | `check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 6355 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | `No changeset declares a major bump.` |
| `node scripts/check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs` / `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` | both OK, exit 0 |

The type-check is **measured, not assumed**, to cover the edited files: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
--listFiles` shows all 13 in their package's test program (components 130 test files in program,
i18n 62, plugin-grid 89; each edited file matched exactly once).

### Changeset gate verdict, verbatim

Before the changeset:

```
❌  12 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset:
```

After (final tree):

```
✅  12 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/7799-cwd-rooted-package-tests.md.
    Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing, which
    is the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate.
```

Empty frontmatter, per the gate's own explicit exemption — no runtime source changed and no
package is released. Never `major`.

## Scope

Clause-② is `no` and was **not** voided: every changed file is a `*.test.ts`/`*.test.tsx`, plus this
card's own changeset. No `package.json` `test` script, no `AGENTS.md`, no `.github/workflows/`, no
non-test file under `packages/*/src`.

`AGENTS.md`'s 怎么跑测试 section still states the package-level form reaches the same conclusion as
CI. This PR makes that true for this class, but the sentence is a governed surface and is left to a
maintainer on **#7800** (`pm:awaiting-maintainer`), which also carries the "give ~40 packages a
repo-root cwd" option — a devx-lane decision, deliberately not taken here.

## Open question for triage, not fixed here

Row 1 (`packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts`) is green and non-vacuous under both
cwds, but its counter-probe shows the two byte-for-byte tests pin the **standalone** generator
branch from the package directory and the **in-workspace** branch from the repo root. That is a
coverage divergence, not a false green, and the cwd mirroring is deliberate — the test compares the
real writer against the builder for whatever the ambient context is. Repairing it is beyond this
card's judgement and would desync the mirror, so it is reported rather than guessed at.
